entities.summary: Sirikitiya Jensen (b. 1985-03-18, San Diego) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in San Diego and Thailand. Known in the fields of thailand, architects & designers, asia.
